layers.title: NISAR radar, before (25 Jun to 19 Jul 2026)
layers.caption: Radar picture from NISAR: the typical echo of 3 passes, 25 Jun to 19 Jul 2026. Red = surface echo (HH), strong from bare ground and buildings. Green = vegetation echo (HV), strong from trees. Blue = how much stronger the surface echo is than the vegetation echo. Woodland looks green-yellow, bare or farmed ground purple-blue, buildings light pink to white, water dark blue. Transparent = no data.
